Montréal Communiqué 


June 155° 1971. 


YMCA Swim Classes 
For Newly Blind 


About 12 newly blind adults are expected to 
be Involved In a special introduction-to-swimming 
program to start June 16th in the Northwestern (NDG) 
YMCA. 

The joint undertaking of the Y and the 
Canadian National Institute of the Blind Is designed 
primarily to orient sightless persons to the water. 

"The first steps are to get participants to 
float, tread water for two minutes and become capable 
of changing direction," says Jean Bonneau, North- 
western YMCA's phys ed director. 

"When he or she can master these skills, they 
move to swimming," comments Bonneau. 


a
